title: Charge sign identification
description: Essential: Student must correctly state that the ball carries positive charge, based on the direction of electric field and equilibrium geometry.

title: Charge magnitude calculation
description: Essential: Student must derive and present the final expression for charge: q = (mg tanθ)/E.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student must resolve forces (gravity, tension, electric) and apply equilibrium conditions in horizontal and vertical directions.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem, accounting for work done by gravity and electric force, to find the speed.

title: Final speed expression
description: Essential: Student must derive and present the final expression for speed: v = √[2gL(1/cosθ - 1)].

title: Geometry and displacement
description: Important: Student must correctly relate the vertical height change (L - L cosθ) to the gravitational potential energy change.

title: Electric force work
description: Optional: Student may note that the electric force is conservative and its work depends on horizontal displacement (L sinθ).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns negative charge, or misplaces the direction of the electric force in the force diagram.

title: Trigonometric mistake
description: Pitfall: Student makes an error in resolving forces (e.g., using sin instead of tan) or in the work-energy geometry.
